name: _nav-controls.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_nav-controls.scss — nav right-side controls: the WebGL burger
//  canvas + the CSS four-squares fallback icon, the always-visible mobile
//  strip, and the 4-column language-dialog variant shared with preferences.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — uses $_B_NAV defined there.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Nav layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// A single menu for every breakpoint: logo on the left, burger on the right,
// everything else lives inside the fullscreen menu modal.

// ── Burger button (WebGL canvas) ──────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: block;
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// ── Burger button wrapper — the shared round disc (like the close button):
// the WebGL canvas paints the liquid squares on top of it, the CSS
// fallback button mirrors the same icon when GL is unavailable. ─────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap {
  position: relative;
  z-index: var(--z-nav);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  background: var(--border-color);
  transition: background 0.2s ease;

  &:hover,
  &:focus-within {
    background: var(--border-color-hover, var(--border-color));
  }
}

// ── Burger button fallback (CSS-based four-squares liquid icon) ──────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-fallback {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  display: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  position: relative;

  // Four rounded squares on a 2x2 grid — the CSS mirror of the shader's
  // metaball icon. Every transform begins with translate(-50%,-50%) so
  // centering survives the width stretch when the squares become the
  // close-X bars; the per-corner offsets follow the recentering.
  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-square {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: var(--space-sm);
    height: var(--space-sm);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    transition:
      transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      width 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      height 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      background 0.3s ease,
      border-radius 0.45s ease;
    transition:
      transform 0.45s $ease-spring,
      width 0.45s $ease-spring,
      height 0.45s $ease-spring,
      background 0.3s ease,
      border-radius 0.45s ease;

    &:nth-of-type(1) {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%)
        translate(calc(-1 * var(--space-sm)), calc(-1 * var(--space-sm)));
    }

    &:nth-of-type(2) {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translate(var(--space-sm), calc(-1 * var(--space-sm)));
    }

    &:nth-of-type(3) {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translate(calc(-1 * var(--space-sm)), var(--space-sm));
    }

    &:nth-of-type(4) {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translate(var(--space-sm), var(--space-sm));
    }
  }

  // Hover/focus: the squares migrate to the center and round into
  // overlapping circles — the CSS approximation of the liquid merge.
  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-square {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.6);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    }
  }

  // Open: the pooled squares pour into THE existing close X — each
  // diagonal pair converges on center and stretches into that bar's
  // exact geometry (the ~17px × 2.6px stroke of the 34px close button),
  // nth 1+4 forming the \ arm and nth 2+3 the / arm. --text-secondary is
  // the same ink the close button's own CSS fallback paints.
  &[aria-expanded='true'] {
    .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-square {
      width: var(--space-xl);
      height: var(--space-xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: var(--text-secondary);

      &:nth-of-type(1),
      &:nth-of-type(4) {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg);
      }

      &:nth-of-type(2),
      &:nth-of-type(3) {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-45deg);
      }
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-burger-wrap:has(.#{$_B_NAV}-burger-canvas.is-fallback) & {
    display: block;
  }
}

// ── Burger strip (always visible) ───────────────────────────────────────────
.#{$_B_NAV}-mobile-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
}

// ── Language dialog variant (4-column option grid) ───────────────────────────
.pref-options--4 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

  @media (max-width: $bk-540) {
    // 540px
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

// Language dialog shell (shared with preferences modal).
.lang-dialog {
  max-width: to-rem(480);
}
